sources.title: WeatherNext 预测气旋：提前五天预警五级飓风 / https://x.com/i/article/2092249927812337664
sources.title_zh: WeatherNext 预测气旋：提前五天预警五级飓风
sources.summary: Google AI 发布 WeatherNext 气旋预测模型，可同时预测风暴路径、强度和规模，比现有系统多提供一整天的预警时间。该模型在 2025 飓风季实战测试中，提前五天预测飓风 Melissa 在牙买加的五级登陆，系美国国家飓风中心首次实时使用 AI 模型。模型单场风暴可生成多达 1000 次模拟，代码与权重已开源。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google DeepMind与Google Research的WeatherNext Cyclones，让美国国家飓风中心首次在2025年飓风季实时使用AI，提前五天预测Melissa五级登陆牙买加；三天预报已达旧两天精度，每场风暴上千次模拟，预警时间多出整整一天。

sources.title_en: How much of HN is AI?
sources.title_original: How much of HN is AI?
sources.summary:
Sure, Waymo’s model is AI and the scams in Apple News are often AI generated, but this isn't some sort of monoculture of LLM articles. Ironically, this article could have been improved by using an LLM to categorize things and also publishing the prompt, so we could inspect what it means to “be AI”.
